rows.abstract: The bill expands the scope of eligibility to apply for parole to:  a) prisoners who have reached 75 years old; and b) prisoners who have served at least five (5) years of their sentence.

rows.title_short: “Department of Agriculture and Fisheries Resources Act of 2004”
rows.abstract: “Department of Agriculture and Fisheries Resources Act of 2004”.  The bill provides for the transfer of powers and functions, appropriations, records, properties, equipment and personnel of agencies involved in aquaculture, fisheries and marine resources from the Department of Agriculture and other related agencies to the Department of Agriculture and Fisheries Resources.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2006-11-06
